All 17 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations redlined (8):**
- **NONCOMPETE** (§12.4) — 24-month, any-territory non-compete on us: deleted.
- **NOSOLICIT** (§12.4) — one-sided 24-month no-hire of all Vendor employees: narrowed to a mutual 12-month non-solicit with advertising/unsolicited carve-outs.
- **MFN** (§7.2) — open-ended obligation for us to disclose and match better third-party offers: deleted.
- **MINCOMMIT** (§2.1) — three-year USD 2M/yr take-or-pay with no exit: narrowed to a 12-month, reducible commitment with a true-up.
- **T4C** (§9) — three-year term with no convenience exit: added a 30-day Customer right with prepaid-fee refund.
- **GOVLAW** (§28.1) — Singapore law/courts (also contradicting §28.2): conformed to New York law and New York County courts.
- **IP** (§14.2) — Vendor owned all Deliverables with only a revocable term licence to us: reversed ownership with a perpetual licence back-stop.
- **INDEMN / TRANSITION** — both clause families absent (the document even cross-refers to a non-existent §20.5): inserted a Vendor indemnity after §21.4 and transition/data-return/deletion obligations after §10.2.

**Compliant (9):** LOL-CAP (mutual greater-of cap with full Excluded Claims), EXCLUSIVITY, RENEWAL, ASSIGN, LICENSE, AUDIT, LD, WARRANTY, INSURANCE — all at or above the preferred position.
